description_en: Translates the speech and on-screen text in a video into a target language. You can select speech subtitle translation, on-screen text translation, or both. This API applies to scenarios such as multilingual distribution of e-commerce videos, international social media marketing, and global brand advertising. The API uses an asynchronous invocation mode. After you submit a translation task, you can obtain the task ID and poll the task status by calling the query API until the task is completed and the result is returned
description_zh:
视频翻译 API 支持将视频中的语音和画面文字翻译为目标语言。您可以单独选择语音字幕翻译、画面文字翻译，或同时选择两种能力。适用于电商视频多语言分发、国际社交媒体营销、全球品牌广告投放等场景。
API 采用异步调用模式：提交翻译任务后获取 TaskId，通过查询接口轮询任务状态直至完成后获取结果
kebab_example: aliyun aidge video-translation --video-url https://cdn.example.com/product-demo.mp4 --capabilities speech --region cn-hangzhou
name: VideoTranslation

parameters.help_en: The video URL. Supported formats: MP4 and MOV. Maximum size: 200 MB
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The target language. This parameter is required
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The source language. For supported languages, see Language support
parameters.help_zh: 源语言，支持范围见“语言支持”
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The list of translation features. Valid values: `speech` and `visual`. You can select both. At least one feature must be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 翻译能力列表：speech、visual，支持同时选择；至少一项，不接受重复值
parameters.name: capabilities

parameters.help_en: The subtitle processing mode. This parameter is valid only when `speech` is included. Valid values: `erase` (removes only the original subtitles) and `replace` (removes the original subtitles and adds new subtitles). If this parameter is omitted, the original subtitles are not processed and no new subtitles are added
parameters.help_zh: 字幕处理模式，仅含 speech 时可传：erase＝仅消除原字幕；replace＝消除原字幕并添加新字幕；省略＝不处理原字幕不新增
parameters.name: subtitle_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to only erase the source language text on the screen without translating it. This parameter is valid only when `visual` is included. Valid values: `true` (only erases the text) and `false` (translates the on-screen text). Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 仅消除画面源语向文字不翻译，仅含 visual 时适用：true＝仅消除；false＝翻译画面文字；省略＝false
parameters.name: erase_only

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to remove the brand logo. This parameter is valid only when `visual` is included. Valid values: `true` (removes the brand logo) and `false` (retains the logo). Default value: `false`. This parameter is independent of `EraseOnly`
parameters.help_zh: 品牌 LOGO 消除，仅含 visual 时适用：true＝消除品牌 LOGO；false＝保留 LOGO；省略＝false。与 eraseOnly 相互独立
parameters.name: remove_logo

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the quality check for on-screen text processing. Default value: `false`. The quality check is enabled only when `visual` is included and this parameter is explicitly set to `true`. If only `speech` is selected, this parameter is ignored. No quality check is performed, no quality check fields are returned, and no errors are reported due to this parameter. Enabling the quality check may increase the waiting time. Do not enable it unless necessary
parameters.help_zh: 默认 false。包含 visual 且显式传 true 时启用画面文字处理质检；仅选择 speech 时忽略此参数，不执行质检、不返回质检字段，也不因该参数报错。开启质检可能延长等待时间，如无必要建议不开启
parameters.name: enable_quality_check

Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The result of the asynchronous task submission

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. You can use this ID for subsequent queries
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询

Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values: `true` (successful) and `false` (failed)
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败
Success.title_en: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
